spec.reasoning: At $250 every date on this tour is already in reach — even the priciest floor, Madison Square Garden at $236, sits under her ceiling — so a price filter would remove nothing and just imply a constraint she does not have. That turns the question from 'what can I afford' into 'which night is worth it', so I dropped the filter, kept chronological order, and highlighted best value (St. Louis, the lowest typical price on the run) rather than cheapest. Standard rather than hero prominence because with no price pressure the list is a browse, not an answer.
